Scope, prerequisites, and privacy

Local checks validate data variables, lifecycle IDs, product-reference syntax, internal links, fragments, and media paths in one host task. Editorial review assesses text in up to five articles, using one agent per article. These modes make no external website requests. Technical review uses the same five-article limit and per-article agents, with a shared public release pin and read-only product-source research. All modes resolve the fixed article set at launch.

Local checks do not verify product availability, prose accuracy, external links, rendered media, navigation, or generated content. Product references can remain unverified because no product manifest is supplied. Editorial judgments do not verify product behavior or media.

Requires installed Node.js and checker dependencies, a trusted checkout, and a Copilot host with background-task APIs. The host can require permissions. It owns execution; this canvas does not sandbox agents, create worktrees, schedule runs, install tools, or interpret article text as instructions.

Saved findings appear while current freshness is checked in a local worker. Checking is not Fresh. Complete, confirmed reports enter the inbox only after full validation. Dismiss, Mark fixed, and Undo record manual decisions against current article bytes while preserving original evidence and freshness. Fix in chat never changes state. Changed observed evidence can reopen decisions. Findings absent from a later applicable scan are never automatically fixed. Failed or incomplete attempts preserve earlier results.

Recent host activity is not saved as a transcript. Hidden execution references support provenance and recovery, not run-history navigation. The task API returns no host deep links. Stopping local freshness verification never cancels a host task. Local review never authorizes documentation edits, GitHub writes, media approval, publication, host-task cancellation, or archiving.

Article review produces scoped agent judgments, not a correctness verdict. Product citations are agent-supplied, and Fresh describes unchanged local inputs. Replay is attended and covers only its reviewed assertions. PR selection, feature documentation, audits, media, and docs-as-eval remain separate workflows.

Continue previously prepared plans and drafts here. For new work, use Write documentation with a brief, a GitHub issue or TPI URL, or both.

Writing scope and privacy

GitHub issues are optional. Planning can research product sources but cannot edit articles or generate media. Plan approval alone starts no edits.

Drafting requires separate confirmation of the location, branch, and file writes. Captures are attended and require exact-asset approval before use. No staging, commits, or publication occur automatically.

Saved plans, approvals, drafts, and checks persist independently of this page. The host owns agent execution; this page is not a security sandbox.
